notes: Pixellum - Professional Pixel Art Studio. A complete browser-based pixel art editor with: layered non-destructive workflow (unlimited layers with visibility, opacity, blend modes, locking), 12 professional tools (Pencil, Eraser, Fill, Color Picker, Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Filled shapes, Select/Move, Lasso, Hand/Pan, Zoom) with keyboard shortcuts; animation timeline with onion skinning, frame management, playback; professional color system with HSV picker, 10 preset palettes (PICO-8, DB16/32, C64, Game Boy, NES, ZX Spectrum, Amstrad, MSX, DawnBringer), custom palette storage; full undo/redo history (100 steps) surviving sessions; autosave to localStorage every 5s with project restore on reload; import/export PNG, animated GIF, and .pixellum project files; drag-and-drop file opening; smooth GPU-accelerated zoom/pan (0.125x-64x) at 60fps; dense professional panelled UI with tooltips, focus states, reduced-motion support, WCAG AA contrast; responsive down to mobile with collapsible panels. No external dependencies, runs from file://, self-contained in single HTML. Organizer note: prompt number and label updated from 12/Professional Creative Tool to 16/Creative Tool after the suite was renumbered. Build unmodified.
